claim: Access to resources inside a CloudHSM cluster uses HSM users directly on the HSMs, not IAM users or IAM policies. IAM users with the correct credentials can create HSMs through the AWS API; after an HSM is created, operations on it are authenticated with HSM user credentials.

evidence.quote: Unlike most AWS services and resources, you do not use AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) users or IAM policies to access resources within your AWS CloudHSM cluster. Instead, you use HSM users directly on HSMs in your AWS CloudHSM cluster.

IAM users who have the correct credentials can create HSMs by interacting with resources through the AWS API. After the HSM is created, you must use HSM user credentials to authenticate operations on the HSM.
